verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is an API-driven payments platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of one, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is an adjacent AI-readability artifact, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
